purpose: Centralize World Map camera-scale vocabulary and capability thresholds so data loading, rendering, labels and interaction do not invent independent zoom semantics.
rule: Zoom is camera scale only. It does not redefine ontology, Axis depth, graph distance, time, evidence strength or epistemic class.

semantics.load: Data may be fetched or promoted into a bounded cache.
semantics.label: Text labels may become visible.
semantics.interact: A feature may become a hover/click target.

migration_note: Subdivision and detailed-place thresholds remain centralized; core country hubs, semantic interior navigation and country relationship visibility now also consume this contract. Remaining physical/fallback-capital thresholds are tracked for later migration.
